independence: Independent of root design author; same reviewer as round3. This is a fourth adversarial design pass, not a claim of a fourth distinct reviewer.
checked: One fixed numeric option changes only output capacity; no environment/user-config override, shell interpolation, permissive catch or new authority surface.
Raw source must still originate from signed exact candidate C and direct signed authority childT;16MiB cannot bypass mode/path restrictions or missing signatures.
Marker suffix after1MiB remains scanned over complete output; late-marker test must demand unresolved-marker diagnostic and complete positive must compare all bytes.
Over16MiB child output remains rejected rather than partially returned; real overflow test should be unambiguous and have valid signed prerequisites.
Existing3ENOBUFS failures must pass unchanged after one-line change; remaining validator/train/planner gates still required.
Fixed perread allowance raises bounded memory pressure and can represent more heap after decoding/splitting; replacement trigger remains measured16MiB overflow.
stop_conditions: Any truncated or partial output accepted.
Generic assertions allowing missing fixture, invalid signature or unrelated read errors to masquerade as overflow proof.
scope: Approval of exact design only. Exact tests and actual runtime evidence require separate review.
